evidence: Swap test fails: a council vaccination clinic or a leisure-centre class booking could use the When, Vehicle, Check-and-book and Booked screens unchanged with only the words swapped (day buttons, a 96px slot-button grid with availability tags, a one-column form, a white reference card, a dark-green filled button).

Category-guess fails: the predicted default for a UK council booking form (pale ground, one sans, one civic green, bordered white cards, error summary box, step text '1. When 2. ... 3. ...') matches every identity-carrying element.
Similar-prompt fails: 'a booking flow for a council's household bulky-waste collection' would land here.

What belongs to the product is only in the copy: 'the gate checks the reference and the vehicle', 'Rubble is limited to four bags and mattresses to two', 'Starts DRC-, then five digits', the reference DR-204117.
The masthead is the council name in bold body text beside a generic bin glyph; there is no signature drawn from the centre (the gate, the bays, Quarry Road, the vehicle classes).

unfinished: no focal point or identity beyond the name 'Dunmore District Council' in bold body text beside a small bin icon
sections that are only a heading and a list: 'What are you bringing?' is seven identical bordered checkbox rows; 'Your details' four bare inputs
columns that stop short: at 1280 and 1440 the slot grid stops at seven columns (~720px) while the Opening days card below spans the full 1088px, leaving an empty right third beside the grid
half-empty width at desktop: vehicle and confirm forms sit in a ~610px column with the right half of the page empty
done page at 1280 and 1440: the footer ends at mid-viewport and an empty grey band fills the rest of the screen
headings that differ from body only in size and weight; one face, no typographic moment even on the done page where the reference is the one thing to look at
an unlabelled 'Few left' group floats above the 'Morning' heading out of time order, so the grid reads as unsorted
phone number split across lines ('01632 / 960771') in the done-page 'At the centre' text at 375
evidence: Judged at the first viewport and one scroll at 375, 1280 and 1440, light and dark.

Pages are clean, consistent and legible, and the dark theme is composed (lighter greens, cards lighter than ground), but nothing on any screen rewards a look: no imagery of the centre, no drawn device, colour limited to a green button and amber tags.
It reads as a default council form. Not unappealing: nothing clashes or breaks.
